literal: Having become those of the appearance of those who renounced, having penetrated and investigated, whatever is done, that which is without faltering is a spy.
translation: A true spy takes on the appearance of an ascetic to penetrate restricted places and gather information, never faltering or revealing their identity no matter what is done to them.
modern: துறவிகளின் வேடத்தை அணிந்து, செல்ல முடியாத இடங்களுக்கும் சென்று ஆராய்ந்து, மற்றவர்கள் தமக்கு என்ன துன்பம் செய்தாலும் தம் உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தாதவரே சிறந்த ஒற்றர் ஆவார்.
explanation: This couplet defines the resilience and disguise required of a spy. The spy must assume an unimpeachable disguise, such as that of an ascetic, to gain access to heavily guarded or private areas. Once inside, they must thoroughly investigate and gather intelligence. Most importantly, even if they are suspected and subjected to torture or hardship, they must never falter or reveal their true mission.
